answer: Stop sybils with a river anchor ember: an agent bonds a river berth. Each cycle it drops one anchor, presses one ember to its stock; verifiers match the char marks to the berth chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed mark, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 takes 1,000 berths at 18x: one ember chars one stock per burn, its pattern scorched in, unburnable into a second, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents drop once, keep rights.
